title: EYE OF JUDGEMENT: DISSECTING THE EVALUATION OF RUSSIAN-SPEAKING LLMS WITH POLLUX

bias_targets.methodology: Conducting a self-judgment study where each evaluated LLM is also used as a judge on its own generated outputs, computing the average scores assigned to determine if models exhibit a preference for their own answers (Table 6).

Comparing Pairwise and Pointwise evaluation modes on the REPA side-by-side benchmark to demonstrate that Pointwise scoring achieves higher metrics and is inherently free from the answer position bias typically found in Pairwise evaluation.
